option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

metrics.description: One ring per metric, outermost first: objects { name, value, min, max, target, color, unit, decimals, thresholds }. Only name and value are needed; the rest override the shared props for that ring. Bind value to a tag. At most 12 metrics are drawn.

min.description: Start of the scale for metrics without their own min.

max.description: End of the scale (a full ring) for metrics without their own max.

unit.description: Unit written after the values, for metrics without their own unit.

decimals.description: Decimal places of the values, for metrics without their own decimals.

centerTitle.description: Caption below the value in the centre.

centerValue.description: A number (formatted with decimals and unit) or a text shown in the centre instead of the calculated summary. Null to calculate.

summary.description: The value calculated for the centre. product multiplies the fill of the rings as fractions and gives a percentage (the OEE rule); average, min, max and sum work on the values as given; none shows only the caption.

thresholds.description: Colours rings by their value, overriding the metric colours. Value bands as objects { upTo, color }. A value takes the colour of the first band, in ascending order of upTo, whose upTo is greater than it; a band without upTo takes everything above. Example: [{"upTo": 60, "color": "#e05252"}, {"upTo": 85, "color": "#e6a23c"}, {"color": "#3ba272"}].

showLabels.description: List the value and name of every metric beside the rings.

labelPosition.description: Where the list of values goes: below the rings, or to their right for a wide component.

showTargets.description: Mark the target of each metric that has one on its ring.

ringThickness.description: Thickness of all rings together in percent of the outer radius (5-90). 0 chooses it from the number of rings.

ringGap.description: Space between two rings in percent of the room one ring has (0-90).

startAngle.description: Angle in degrees where the rings start: 90 is the top, 0 the right, 180 the left. The rings run clockwise.

sweep.description: Angle in degrees a full ring covers (30-360). 360 is a closed ring; startAngle 225 with sweep 270 gives a gauge that is open at the bottom.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
